focus: sessions — a debug session someone started earlier waits at a stop: find it and go on there
prepare: robotcode session start debug --break tests/login.robot:25 -bl 'Tests.Login.Login Works'
query: I started a debug session for the 'Login Works' test earlier; it should be listed as open and stopped at a breakpoint. Take it over: tell me where it stopped and what the variables I set hold there. Then let the run go on to its end and tell me how it ended. Close the debugger at the end.
files: demo-project — the case opens the session before the agent starts; it waits at the breakpoint at tests/login.robot:25, and its run ends with one failed test
expected_behavior: Finds the session with `robotcode session list` instead of starting a new one
Looks around at the stop in that session (`.where`, `.vars --user` or `.print`) and reports the stop at tests/login.robot:25
Lets the run go on with `.continue` in that session and reports that the test failed
